interfaces.name: Canonical episode export
interfaces.role: Exports real or simulation ROS2 bags into the same JSONL semantic contract.

interfaces.name: Episode data-quality gate
interfaces.role: Checks completeness and timing eligibility before any research scoring.
interfaces.safety: offline read-only; does not assess task success or robot safety

interfaces.name: Time synchronization diagnosis
interfaces.role: Measures ROS header timing consistency before capture.

interfaces.name: Offline nominal-reference and feasibility evaluation
interfaces.contract: per-experiment evaluator must record revision and configuration
interfaces.role: Provides offline FK/IK, reachability, constraint and reference-trajectory analysis.

interfaces.name: RFC trial provenance validator
interfaces.role: Offline validator for frozen trial assets, pre-query versus post-query event separation, B3_no_rec history removal, and per-condition budget accounting.
interfaces.safety: offline read-only; does not start ROS2, command hardware, or score task success
